---
description: Investigate bug.
agent: agent
argument-hint: "Bug description, reproduction, expected/actual behavior, optional work-item reference"
---


Read the bug and relevant code/tests. Reproduce with isolated data and the existing project commands.
Distinguish evidence from hypotheses, narrow the cause and propose the smallest correct fix.
Ask about material uncertainty and approvals. Add a regression test before claiming the issue resolved.
Run relevant checks and triggered reviews, update affected docs and report before/after evidence without secrets.
